g.text: Auth 1 of 3 · Sign-up and email verification
before the service ever sees it
The limit is per email address:
this route sends mail to an address
Looks up the account by email
This is how someone who never confirmed
and also forgot their password gets back in
Nothing is created. The response is identical
in all three cases: this route never reveals
Clicks the link in the email
The token travels in the body, not the URL:
URLs end up in logs and in the Referer header
Verifies the email and consumes the token
Queues the new one, if the account is eligible
202 whether or not the account exists,
for the same reason as sign-up
